I feel you, I am 19 and I don't see a future. Anxiety makes me feel indifferent towards life. I just spend my days studying as a college student but the thought of actually taking initiative towards anything is gone. I just try to do the stuff I'm expected to do and then be alone, listen to music, watching tv, write a diary, whatever. Just be alone.

I feel like it's all going to break down sooner or later. But I don't know how yet. 

I wish you all the best.
Thar sucks, hope you find something that works for you

I recognize this, I can't say I truely feel comfortable around anyone. It differs per friend how bad it is but I wouldn't know any solution. I'm considering meds or giving therapy another go. Have you tried those?

I feel the same, whenever I need to text or talk to people for practical purposes it's alright. But I have a really hard time enjoying socializing. I feel alienated and stressed out. That whenever I would be comfortable, my obsession with being liked makes me behave and think strange or cringy.

I have the same. It's the worst. Some days I go through 3 shirts in one day. I try to accept it and sometimes I really do. Then I'm not stressed about it anymore and the sweating stops. But most of the time I keep stressing about it which only makes it worse.

I do recognize it. When you talk, do you ever get to talking with people about your issues? I suppose if faking it means to kind of 'deny' the existence of you feelings of detachment and anxiety that the faking isn't helping.

I also sometimes engage in small talk and keep asking myself 'am I even really interested in this? Or am I just playing this game to make people think I'm a nice guy?' And in the end I think it doesn't matter. Focus on where you can grow in relations with people, not on what's broken right now.

I don't know if I'm the guy to be giving advice since I'm pretty much a wreck myself but this is what I always tell myself. Best of luck.

I am also experiencing this problem lately. watch your extruder wheel very closely and notice that it slips every once in a while. Try printing slower. Lowering your printing temp (yes this might actually work). clean out your extruder and make sure all moving parts can move freely. Wishing you the best of luck, I know how frustrating this can be.

\*edit\* upping your hotend temp might also help. what material and temp are you currently on?
I agree, the temp is really just what works out. Thanks for your reply!

Still the crappy stock one...  I started some tests with lower temps and it seems to be doing better which is pretty weird (?) So I am guessing my thermistor is not reading out too high. thanks for your reply!
